+    print("MOVE", tag, "targets", arr[:, :3].tolist(), flush=True)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", arr, cameras=["over_shoulder_left_camera", "wrist_cam"],
+                   video="none", note=tag)
+    print("RESULT", tag, json.dumps({"done": res.meta.get("done"), "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+                                     "plan": res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+                                     "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+                                     "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s")}, default=str), flush=True)
+    for cam, img in res.last.items():

+        Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT / f"{tag}_{cam}.png")
+    print("TCP", np.round(res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15], 4).tolist(), flush=True)
+    return res

+def pick_place(r, name, grasp, grasp_z, dest_grasp, hover_z=0.27, carry_z=0.27):
+    """Top-down pinch, lift, transfer, and release one utensil."""
+    x, y = map(float, grasp)
+    dx, dy = map(float, dest_grasp)

+    move(r, [pose([x, y, hover_z], 0), pose([x, y, grasp_z + 0.006], 0)], f"{name}_approach")
